body: Shiv Shankar Gupta (CFO) on 2024-07-30 (Q1FY25 concall transcript): "expect to gross revenue growth in excess of 25% each year for the next 2 financial years" Metric: Consolidated revenue growth YoY. Target: >25% in FY25 and in FY26. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: precise; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-19: partly. Evidence: FY25 +41% (beat); FY26 revenue 5,552.8 cr = +20.1% (Q4FY26 call; screener 5,553) vs >25% promised. One of two years delivered. Explanation given: Rajasthan monsoon, second-capacity delay, export/Middle East disruption (given Nov-25 and Jan-26, only when asked)
